## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `f9e6bada7dae37ef5ed98cf0b1576c297a0bcbfd`
Local-runs: none
Scope: `.changeset/36511-studio-save-cancel.md`, `.changeset/36511-studio-save-cancel-3.md`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/PackageOwdOverviewPanel.tsx`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioAiDraftNotice.tsx`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/en.ts`, `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/zh.ts`, the 29 changed test files (diff read for removed assertions) + `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/studioSaveBar.tsx`, `ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/metadata-client.ts`, `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts`, `packages/rest/src/meta-item-history-routes.ts`, `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`, `scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs`, `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/landing-operations.md`, `AGENTS.md`, issues #36511 and #36510, PR comment 7096114323
Security-touching: yes
Rule-change-verified: none

Diff base: `f590f3eb322a75259f55e7e604978fe94dd9a3fe` (merge-base with `origin/main`). 37 files, all under `.changeset/` and `ui/packages/`.

### ① Derived judgments

- `Clause-②: no` is true. The diff touches no file under `packages/`, so nothing in `packages/spec/src/**` moves.
- `Metadata-protocol: none` is true. No schema, no authorable baseline, no server route and no protocol code is in the diff.
- Package exports: unchanged. No `index.ts` is in the diff. `PermissionMatrixEditPage` is the one exported component touched; it gains one optional prop, `onSaved`. `PackageOwdOverviewPanel` loses its `onDraftSaved` prop, and `StudioAiDraftNotice` is new; neither is exported from `@object-ui/app-shell`.
- i18n: en and zh carry the same key set after the change. Six keys added (`engine.studio.aiDraft.notice`, `.discard`, `.discardTitle`, `.discardConfirmUnsaved`, `.discardFailed`, `engine.studio.createLive`), five values reworded, three keys removed (`engine.studio.owd.save`, `.saveNone`, `.saved`). No source file still reads the three removed keys.
- The AI discard is per item. `DataPillar.discardItemDraft` calls `client.reset('object', name, { state: 'draft', packageId })`, where `packageId` is the address the object's draft was read at (`current.addedIn ?? railPackageId`). `AutomationsPillar.discardFlowDraft` calls `client.reset('flow', name, { state: 'draft', packageId })` at the package the flow was read at. `MetadataClient.reset` sends `DELETE /meta/:type/:name?state=draft&package=`. Neither calls `packages.discardDrafts`.
- The server accepts it. `META_ITEM_RESET_PARAMS` in `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts` is `['state', 'dropStorage', 'package', member]`. The route is not changed by this PR.

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/36511-studio-save-cancel-3.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch and `@object-ui/i18n` patch. Correct for `Metadata-protocol: none`, which requires every entry to be `patch`. Both declaration lines are in the changeset body and in the PR body, and they agree.
- The new note's claims were checked against the head and hold: object, flow and permission-set creates call `publishSavedItem` (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` lines 6633, 8846, 10779); the app, page, dashboard, report and dataset dialogs still use `engine.studio.createDraft`; the OWD panel has no Save button of its own; a permission set in Studio blocks the autosave (`saveByTopBar`).

DELIBERATE CORRECTION confirmed: no — this record is FAIL, so it confirms nothing at this head. The sentence itself is judged true, and that judgment stands for a later head that leaves the sentence unchanged. Note corrected: `.changeset/36511-studio-save-cancel.md`, last sentence only; no other pending changeset is modified.
- Base: "Other Studio editors (flows, hooks, list and form views, navigation, permissions) keep their draft autosave for now."
- This PR: "Hooks, flows and permission sets moved to the same Save in later changes; list views and navigation keep their draft autosave for now."
- The base sentence is false on main already: `objectHooksBuffer.ts` and the flow page register with `useStudioSaveEntry` at `f590f3eb3` (#36634).
- The new sentence is true of main plus this PR. Hooks and flows: on main, from #36634. Permission sets: this PR (`PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx`, `useStudioSaveEntry` with the autosave blocked). List views and navigation: still `useDraftAutoSave` on the head (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` lines 3628 and 3826).
- The sentence is not a full list. Interface leaves (pages, dashboards, reports) and package bundle items also still autosave. It does not claim to be complete, so this is not an error.

### ③ Boundary flags

- should-fix 1 — OWD overview, controlled-by-parent confirm after an earlier row went live. `PackageOwdOverviewPanel.doSave` saves and publishes rows one by one. When a later row answers `409 DESTRUCTIVE_CHANGE`, it opens the prerequisite dialog and returns `declined` from inside the loop, without the `load()` the normal partial path runs. Rows already published in that pass are live but still shown as "Unsaved". If the person closes the dialog and presses the top bar's Cancel, `doCancel` puts those dials back to the stale loaded value, so the page shows a record-visibility setting the server no longer holds. Before this PR the early return left only drafts behind; now it leaves live changes. Fix: reload and restore only the unsaved rows' edits before returning, or handle the prerequisite before any row is published. Pin it with a two-row test.
- should-fix 2 — the OWD partial-refusal path has no test. The code reads correctly: a refused row keeps its edit, saved rows go live, the reason names each refused row, and a refused publish takes back the draft that pass wrote (`publishSavedItem` with `row.hasDraft`). But none of the nine OWD suites makes `publish` or a second row's `save` refuse; every fake `publish` resolves. The PR body claims this behaviour. It is new logic on a record-visibility surface and needs a pin.
- Permission-set refused publish: correct and pinned. `doSave` calls `publishSavedItem(..., hadDraftRef.current)`. On refusal it returns `refused`, does not reset the baseline (the grant stays dirty), and the draft the Save wrote is deleted when no draft was pending before. `PermissionMatrixEditor.studioSave-36511` asserts PUT, POST, then `DELETE ...?state=draft&package=`, the box still checked, Save still drawn, and no success toast. A draft that was pending before the Save is kept, as designed.
- AI discard asks first: yes. Both discards call `window.confirm` when the page is dirty (`dirty` for the object, `autoDirty` for the flow) and send nothing when declined. Pinned in `DataPillar.aiDraftDiscard-36511`.
- Person-written draft shows no AI notice: yes. The object line needs `agentDraftCount > 0` and the flow line needs a `draftChanges` entry whose `by` is `copilot` or `mcp`. Both have a CONTROL test.
- Weakened tests: none found. Removed assertions were re-stated against the top bar: "Save disabled" became "no Save drawn"; `layersUnsaved-11799` goes from 0 to 1 layer reads because the object is now published; `changesCount-11787` moved to Create app, which still writes a draft; `oneLabel-11787` gained a second control.
- Server-side authority: unchanged. No server file is in the diff. The client uses three existing doors (draft PUT, `POST /meta/:type/:name/publish`, `DELETE ...?state=draft`), and each decides for itself who may act. A permission set now goes live through the per-item publish door instead of the package publish door. I did not compare the two doors' gates line by line.
- note — the per-item discard asks nothing when the page is clean, and it cannot be undone. On an item the AI created and that was never published, the discard removes the item, while the button title says "go back to the live version". The Access pillar's own discard asks, with a separate sentence for a never-published set.
- note — in the OWD partial path, when the only refused row kept a draft that was pending before, the reload shows the row as clean and the `!isDirty` effect clears the inline banner. The top bar's toast still carries the reason.
- note — comment drift: `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` near line 11382 ("each writes a draft") above `createLive`; the `studio` prop doc in `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx` ("Presentation only: every write, gate and autosave is the routed page's"), now untrue because `studio` selects the save path; the "package's atomic Publish promotes" comment above `saveVersioned`.

### ④ Design judgment

- Nothing in the diff contradicts the ruling 「人改一项、点保存、立刻生效。草稿加整包发布只留给 AI」. Human edits to permission sets, the OWD overview and field layout are now buffered and go live on Save. Changes and Publish are left to drafts.
- note — card item 6 is done for objects and flows only, and the PR body says so. A permission set, a hook, an added action or an OWD row that holds an AI draft publishes that draft with the person's Save and draws no AI line. For a permission set this means AI-written grants go live with an unrelated human grant. The page does open on the draft version, the Access pillar still offers "Discard draft", and the OWD row shows "Unpublished draft" until it is edited. This is a scope limit, not a contradiction of the ruling. The seat should decide whether it needs a follow-up card.
- No design fork needs the maintainer.

DELIBERATE CORRECTION confirmed: yes — `.changeset/36511-studio-save-cancel.md`, last sentence only. The file is byte-identical to the round-1 head (`git diff f9e6bada7..a4ee300c4 -- .changeset` is empty), and no other pending changeset is modified.

Permission sets: this PR (`PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx`, `useStudioSaveEntry`, autosave blocked under `saveByTopBar`). Cancel then restores from fresh rows, so it can no longer show a value the server does not hold.

Test 3 would also see a second save and publish of `a_alpha`. Test 1 pins behaviour the old code already had; that is the pin round 1 asked for.

## 维护者速读
「人改完点保存、立刻生效」这件事的最后一步：权限集、对象访问总览、字段布局也改成右上角「取消 / 保存」，保存即生效；新建对象、流程、权限集时按钮写「创建」，建好就生效。
AI 留下没发布的改动时，页面会提示「保存会一并生效」，也可以只放弃这一项 AI 的改动。人和 AI 同时改一项时，保存会被拦下并让人选「覆盖」或「重新载入」，不会悄悄丢改动。
复核两轮后通过；CI 除一项按规则预期的红灯外全绿，约 1500 行（多为测试），非受管面，席位落地。合并后这张卡关闭。
要你做的：无。
